# Vendor libraries

Bundled locally so the theme makes no third-party script requests.

| File | Version | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gsap.min.js | 3.13.0 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.13.0 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License, https://gsap.com/standard-license (free, including commercial use) |
| ScrollTrigger.min.js | 3.13.0 | same | same |
| SplitText.min.js | 3.13.0 | same | same |
| lenis.min.js | 1.1.13 | cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.13/dist | MIT |

Lenis's stylesheet (lenis.css) is inlined at the end of assets/css/base.css.
To update: replace the files with the same names and bump the version in this table.
